text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooohhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Bamboo Memory! Bamboo Memory!
Bamboo Memory breaks through!
Bamboo Memory takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory crosses the line!!!
Bamboo Memory takes a commanding victory!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap!! What was that acceleration?!
That's just completely ridiculous!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If she races Oguri in a mile again,
she might actually have a shot, don't you think?
Man, I'd love to see that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid.
A run truly befitting the pinnacle of sprint racing.
I have etched it firmly into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And now, the next challenge is finally—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I won—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I won...!
I really did...! In the Sprinters Stakes!
I'm standing at the pinnacle of sprint racing!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooooooohh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!! That was god-tier~!!
Bamboo's running was insane,
it totally hyped me up~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna aim to run hype like that too!
A passionate party animal is totally the strongest combo!! For now, big vibes~!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh, it's finally sinkin' in!
That I really became the strongest sprinter...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And following the sprint—
choice_data_list: The Mile CS— I'll seize the top there!
The Mile CS— I'll seize the top there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Oguri-senpai will run for us?

"Because to Bamboo Memory,
Oguri Cap is already becoming her greatest rival...!"

—And a few days later.
Just as Bamboo Memory had hoped, Oguri Cap's entry into the Mile Championship was officially announced...!
Meanwhile, as for Bamboo Memory—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight!
It's finally complete!!
Yaeno, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. This was my first time helping out like this,
so it was an honor to be of assistance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's a challenge letter for Oguri-senpai!
Yaeno is used to this kind of stuff, so I had her check it over!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Chiyono O-san, Ardan-san, and I are all
eagerly looking forward to the showdown
between Bamboo-san and Oguri-san."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't help but anticipate it. Wondering if you will bring a massive change to what is now called the 'Oguri Cap Era.'

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! To be honest, I haven't really
thought about anything that huge yet.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've only got one wish, sir!
……I want Oguri-senpai and me
to become the "ultimate rivals" for each other!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So I definitely won't lose! I won't give it up!
That's all there is to it!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Trainer!
I'm gonna head over to Oguri-senpai's right away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Actually,
I've already set up an appointment!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaalright, off I gooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Plain and simple. But that is precisely how it should be.
It is because you are someone so devotedly earnest toward your "dream"—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The era will begin to surge with you at its center.
I cannot help but believe so.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Oguri-senpai!!
Sorry to keep you waiting!!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. I just got here myself. So, what was it you needed—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This is the one!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is this a letter...?
Do you want me to deliver it...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no! It's totally meant for you, Senpai!
It's a challenge letter from me!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—At the upcoming Mile CS, I'm going to beat
Oguri-senpai and prove that I'm the
strongest miler of this generation!!!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this, Oguri-senpai!!
For the title of the strongest! —As "rivals"!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to tell me directly,
didn't you not need to hand over a challenge letter?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Y-You have a point!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—No, no, no, that's not it!
It's not about whether there's a point to it or not!!
That's just how these things are!!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The important thing is my desire to have a serious match
with Oguri-senpai!!
This is just proof of that!!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel.
I was looking forward to competing against Bamboo in the Mile CS too, so I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this, Bamboo Memory.
...To see who's truly the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who will win.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about!!
That's our Oguri-senpai!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose to you, Senpai!!!
The winner is gonna be—ME!!!
